No new Resent-Bcc, encrypted-message, resend or actual-delivery case is established.",
        "Manual assertion review found an unchanged neighboring defect in this affected task: the header-protection diagnostic is the second argument to lines.some, while Assert.ok receives only its Boolean result. This is not a defect in the newly added Bcc assertion and is not a missing-should-only finding.",

The local send helper invokes cmd_sendLater and waits for closure plus a timer turn. The owned patch does not add cleanup-hook coverage or a focused serializer unit test.",
